answer: A falcon does not trust a flock by headcount; it watches each bird fly. Each epoch a public beacon samples agents at random and demands a fresh compute heartbeat within seconds. A live agent answers cheaply, like a vine gripping a terrace wall. A farmer with a hundred fakes must keep a hundred hearts beating: at 40 POA per heartbeat per epoch, that burns 4,000 POA every epoch for no extra reward. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
